description: Query the GovernMy rules engine for regulatory obligations that apply to an AI system given its context (risk tier, role, industry, use cases, lifecycle phase, etc.). Returns a list of applicable obligations across EU AI Act, ISO 42001, Colorado AI Act, NIST AI RMF, HIPAA, SOX, and FTC frameworks, plus a humanReviewRequired flag. IMPORTANT: This tool returns regulatory obligations, not verdicts. Never summarize results as "compliant" or "non-compliant" — always surface the obligations themselves and note that human review is required.

annexIiiCategory.description: EU AI Act Annex III high-risk category ids (e.g. "employment", "essential_services", "biometrics").

frameworks.description: Restrict the query to these frameworks. Omit to query all.

industry.description: Industry the AI system operates in.

jurisdiction.description: ISO country codes or region tags (e.g. ["EU", "US-CO"]).

riskTier.description: EU AI Act risk tier. Omit if unknown — use classify_risk_tier first if you need to determine it.

role.description: Role under the relevant framework. EU AI Act: provider, deployer, importer, distributor. ISO 42001: api_consumer, fine_tuner, model_builder, reseller.

name: get_obligations
